verdict.rationale: Tax agencies that run online filing portals can plausibly offer programmatic API access, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a human-login My DOR account, phone, and mail channels. The OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and nothing documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
